newsitem.title: FINLAND: ESPOON SAHKO SEES PRETAX PROFIT UP IN '96.
newsitem.headline: ESPOON SAHKO SEES PRETAX PROFIT UP IN '96.

text.p: Finnish regional power grid operator Espoon Sahko Oy said on Friday it expected its full-year profit to rise in 1996 compared to 1995.

"The operating margin and the profit before appropriations and taxes are estimated to improve on last year, provided no unexpected increases in energy purchases prices or other costs occur," it said in a statement with its January-August results.
"The assessment is based on the (January-August) result and the view on market development in the rest of the year," Espoon Sahko said.
Its 1995 pretax profit was 131 million markka.
In January-August, Espoon Sahko's profit before taxes rose to 99 million markka from 73 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
Next year, Espoon Sahko saw increased competition.
"Competition on the electricity market will expand next year so that the 500 kilowatt power limit is removed. This is expected to further increase competition in the sector," it said.
